entities.name: Henry B. Sayler
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henry Benton Sayler was an American lawyer, Civil War veteran, and politician who served one term as a U.S. representative from Indiana from 1873 to 1875. He was a cousin of Milton Sayler, who also served in the U.S. House of Representatives.
